terra.problem: “All that noise” refers to earlier events, but gives no reference for them.
The passage does not say that nobody is waving a branch at the altar.
“All at once” adds timing the text does not give for the thunder, rumblings, lightning, and earthquake.
“I'd have grabbed the counter too” implies an earlier counter-grabbing setup. The matching line is in another answer explanation, which the baker would not see.
“When the sea turned to blood” makes it sound as though the whole sea changed. The text says a third of it did.
“The light drops by a third” suggests reduced brightness. The text says a third of the day and a third of the night were without light.
Saying the fourth trumpet strikes the sun, moon, and stars identifies what struck them. The text says they were struck after the trumpet sounded, without saying what struck them.
